desc: Implement + wire the splat terrain CSM caster, no culling yet (draw every loaded chunk into every cascade, like the player caster). In c-engine/renderer/diligent/SplatTerrainDiligent.{h,cpp}: add splatTerrainShadowDrawDiligent(ctx, rawWorldToLightProjSpace, cascadeDSV) mirroring gltfDiligentShadowDraw's signature. Lazy shadow-pass init: compile materials/splat_terrain_shadow_vs.hlsl + splat_terrain_shadow_ps.hlsl (c-game/data/pak_1) via the existing createSplatHlsl, one PRS for cbSplatShadowCaster, 0-color-target D32_FLOAT PSO (atlas format) with a single dummy cascade-sized RT fallback if the 0-RT desc is rejected. Per cascade: SetData cLightViewProj = the RAW mgr cascade WorldToLightProjSpace TRANSPOSED once (the splat runtime-HLSL family is row-vector math, same convention as splatFrameTranspose at SplatTerrainDiligent.cpp:865-876 — uploading it untransposed is the #1 trap) + g_Anchor = this frame's diligentWorldAnchor() as f32 (read fresh at draw time, never cached). NO rasterizer depth bias (PBR caster draws bias-free; the receiver already subtracts its own bias — a rasterizer bias here double-peter-panns). Reuse the existing per-chunk VBO/IBO (SplatVertex 48B, u16 indices). Gate: shared predicate splatTerrainShadowDrawsDiligent() = ENGINE_SPLAT_TERRAIN not "0" && splatTerrainDiligent() loaded && taaColorRTV() non-null && splatShadowsOn() (PCF mode only) — same preconditions the world pass uses (SplatTerrainDiligent.cpp:1507-1520). In ShadowDiligent.cpp renderCascadesImpl, call it in the per-cascade loop right after gltfDiligentShadowDraw under Diligent::ScopedDebugGroup(ctx,"terrain"), passing the same cascadeDSV + raw matrix. Release all caster-owned GPU resources (PSO, PRS/SRB, dummy RT, cbuffer) in splatPassRelease / splatTerrainDestroyDiligent. Init must be independent of splatPassInit (no TAA-chain dependency) but gated at draw time. No code comments (project rule). Verify: ninja -C build clean, then TERM=xterm-256color timeout 60 env ENGINE_HIDDEN_WINDOW=1 VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/radeon_icd.json ENGINE_AUTOTEST=enter ENGINE_SHADOW_READBACK=300 ENGINE_SCREENSHOT=/tmp/splat_caster.jpg ./build/c-game/c-game — expect a new log line (shadow caster pass ready), no validation errors, per-cascade readback showing terrain-scale geometry coverage (much wider geometry bbox uv than the player-only blob, far cascades non-empty), and screenshot with plausible sun-angle self-shadowing, no detached/mirrored shadow. A/B: same run with ENGINE_SPLAT_TERRAIN=0 — terrain absent from the atlas, player shadow unchanged.
result: splatTerrainShadowDrawDiligent implemented + wired under the terrain group (0-RT D32 PSO accepted); 16/16 chunks drawn, readback shows terrain-scale coverage, A/B SPLAT_TERRAIN=0 clean.

desc: Add cascade frustum culling to the splat caster: 8-corner anchor-space AABB test of each chunk against the cascade light box (transform chunk AABB corners with the same transposed W2L, anchor-subtracted with the fresh f32 anchor, NDC box test — do NOT use the FrustumCull.h 6-plane helper, its glNdc=false far plane can be aggressive if the cascade projection remaps z). Small margin on the box. ENGINE_SHADOW_CASTER_NOCULL=1 bypasses culling (must reproduce task-1 output exactly). One-shot per-frame log of chunks drawn per cascade. Verify: readback occupancy, draw counts, and /tmp screenshot identical to task 1; draw counts drop for far cascades.
result: 8-corner anchor-space light-box cull with 2-px NDC margin + NOCULL bypass + per-cascade log; draw counts drop (12/16, 13/16), readback byte-identical to unculled, NOCULL reproduces task 1 exactly (note: in-chunk geometry behind the near plane stays — chunk-level cull limitation, no per-triangle clip).

desc: Verification sweep: capture with ENGINE_RENDERDOC_CAPTURE=1 ENGINE_RENDERDOC_CAPTURE_FRAMES=300 ./scripts/run.sh renderdoc, then scripts/rdc.py list + scripts/rdc.py dump terrain (pass present under shadow, depth writes sane — read docs/renderdoc-capture.md first). If flat-ground self-shadowing or peter-panning shows in the screenshot, A/B with ENGINE_PBR_BIAS_SCALE (receiver-side knob only — the caster must stay bias-free). The combined screenshot+readback command needs ENGINE_SCREENSHOT_FRAME=300 (default frame-100 capture quits before the frame-300 readback). Note the headless autotest is camera-static, so anchor-drift detachment can only be checked via renderdoc/screenshot, not a moving-camera run. Clean up old /tmp/RenderDoc captures (~400MB each). Finish with the full ledger verification command from plan.md.
result: Renderdoc sweep clean (terrain pass 12/13 draws matching culled log, D32 atlas confirmed, caster bias-free); live depth dumps sane, full ledger verification + A/B pass; noted RenderDoc headless D32 SaveTexture is untrustworthy in this build — use engine dumps.

desc: Close the notes.md 'Open question': confirm terrain self-shadowing visually, or definitively document why it can't be confirmed headlessly. In order of preference: (a) check whether any env knob / autotest option can change the camera position or sun direction to bring a shadowed terrain face into view (the static autotest camera at (180,683.74,180) sees only the lit side; sun is nearly behind the camera) — if so, run it with ENGINE_SCREENSHOT and show a shadowed face; (b) else use RenderDoc color-pass dumps (color passes replay correctly — only D32 SaveTexture is untrustworthy in this build): replay the world pass (nested 'terrain' group) for a fresh capture with shadows on and again with the splat receiver shadow path off (e.g. the PCF/shadows-mode knob) and diff the terrain region — pixels that darken at locations consistent with the atlas bbox (uv (0.000,0.381)..(0.692,0.611) cascade1) confirm PCF self-shadowing end-to-end; (c) if neither is feasible, close the open question in notes.md with the documented reason. Clean up any new /tmp/RenderDoc captures (~400MB each) when done. Read docs/renderdoc-capture.md first if using renderdoc.
result: Closed in round 5: no renderdoc needed — the static camera DOES see cast PCF shadow on the lit faces. A/B ENGINE_PBR_NO_RECEIVE=1 (existing receiver-off hook) vs default: 29.1% of terrain pixels >8 levels darker in ON, only 0.01% brighter (TAA noise is symmetric), heatmap traces ridgeline silhouette with soft PCF edges; caster 12/16+13/16 and readback byte-identical to rounds 1-4; darkened pixels read cascade-1 bbox via shadowDiligentPbrSlice. Evidence /tmp/t5_*.jpg, no code changes.
